name: Do I need fire-rated drywall for my garage?

mainEntity.name: Do I need fire-rated drywall for my garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building codes often require fire-rated drywall, specifically Type X, on walls and ceilings separating an attached garage from living spaces in your home. This is a critical safety measure designed to slow the spread of fire, providing occupants more time to evacuate. Even for detached garages, fire-rated drywall can offer enhanced protection for stored items. It's essential to check local building codes in Bay Area cities like Pacifica or Daly City, as requirements can vary. A professional contractor can advise on specific compliance needs for your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fire-rated drywall (Type X) is often required by building codes on walls separating attached garages from living areas for safety. Check local Bay Area codes.
